title: Analysis code for: Reduced CD207+ Langerhans-cell transcriptomic signature in lesional psoriasis - a transparency-focused two-group single-cell re-analysis with replication across three independent bulk cohorts
description: R and Python code reproducing every number, table and figure of the accompanying manuscript from five public GEO series (GSE173706, GSE162183, GSE13355, GSE14905, GSE30999). Includes identifier harmonisation, cell-level QC and doublet removal, Harmony integration, lineage annotation, myeloid/DC subclustering, the pre-specified one-sided Jonckheere-Terpstra ordered-trend test with Benjamini-Hochberg correction on donor-level pseudo-samples, two-group pseudobulk differential expression, GO/Hallmark enrichment, GSVA, three independent bulk validations, and the post hoc supplementary layer (composition controls and empirical null, maturation axis, transcription-factor activity). Raw data, intermediate objects and derived result tables are not included.
